channel.title: Trizlink Docs
channel.description: How Trizlink works, from the code: short links, bio pages, QR codes, click analytics that store no visitor IP address, and what is not switched on.

item.title: White-label and licensing
item.description: How a Trizlink white-label licence works, what the source buyout hands over, how updates and renewals run, and how anyone can verify a licensed deployment.

item.title: White-label questions
item.description: Answers to the questions buyers ask about a Trizlink white-label licence and the source buyout, from source code and exclusivity to iOS and acquired products.

item.title: What each platform group delivers
item.description: The two Trizlink platform groups a white-label licence can cover, the web app and the mobile app, what each one includes, and when iOS is built.

item.title: From payment to a running deployment
item.description: What happens after a Trizlink white-label payment, in order: the licence email and certificate, the setup of domain and branding, and the deployment with its licence file.

item.title: Updates and renewals
item.description: The six months of Trizlink updates included with every white-label licence and buyout, what counts as an update, and how a 3, 6 or 12 month renewal is counted.

item.title: Verifying a licence
item.description: How to check whether a deployment of Trizlink is licensed, by its licence key or by its domain, and what each answer from the licensing service means.

item.title: Moving to Trizlink
item.description: Step-by-step guides for moving from 37 link shorteners, bio page hosts and social schedulers to Trizlink, with what stays behind and dated facts.

item.title: Moving from Agorapulse to Trizlink
item.description: Agorapulse keeps the inbox and publishing; the link-in-bio and protected links move to Trizlink. Agorapulse's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Beacons to Trizlink
item.description: Keep the Beacons store and media kit, move the plain links and forms to a Trizlink bio page. Beacons' prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Bio Link to Trizlink
item.description: Rebuild a Bio Link page in Trizlink; the AI chat and collected emails stay behind. Bio Link's price and the rows its pages left out, dated.

item.title: Moving from Bitly to Trizlink
item.description: Export your Bitly links, rename the columns and import them into Trizlink. Why bit.ly addresses and printed codes stay put. Bitly's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from BL.INK to Trizlink
item.description: Product labelling stays on BL.INK; marketing links can move to Trizlink. Which is which, how to import, and BL.INK's quote-only pricing, dated.

item.title: Moving from Buffer to Trizlink
item.description: Buffer keeps posting, because Trizlink's publishing is switched off. Move the Start Page and the links. Buffer's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Campsite.bio to Trizlink
item.description: Move many Campsite.bio profiles: one workspace per client, duplicate a finished page, swap embedded forms. Campsite.bio's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Carrd to Trizlink
item.description: When a Carrd site is really a bio page, rebuild it with Trizlink blocks; when it is a website, keep it. Carrd's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Cuttly to Trizlink
item.description: From Cuttly to Trizlink: export, map five roles onto four, keep your UTM tags and rebuild bio pages. Cuttly's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Dub to Trizlink
item.description: Keep Dub's partner payouts, move the other links through its API and a CSV, and switch your scripts to Trizlink's API. Dub's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Hootsuite to Trizlink
item.description: Hootsuite keeps the inbox, listening and publishing; the link work and the seats that only made links can move. Prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Hopp by Wix to Trizlink
item.description: Move Hopp's shortener links by CSV first, then rebuild the page. Email marketing stays with Wix. Hopp's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Komi to Trizlink
item.description: Products and campaigns stay on Komi; the page, YouTube and Spotify blocks move to Trizlink. Komi's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Later to Trizlink
item.description: Keep posting from Later and move its bio page to Trizlink, with expiring links for offers. Later's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Linkly to Trizlink
item.description: Bring Linkly links across and rebuild their country and device rules by hand. Linkly's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Linktree to Trizlink
item.description: Rebuild a Linktree as a Trizlink bio page block by block, and what stays behind: sign-ups, sales and history. Linktree's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Lnk.Bio to Trizlink
item.description: Keep Lnk.Bio for scheduled Instagram and TikTok posts and move the page to Trizlink. Lnk.Bio's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Loomly to Trizlink
item.description: Loomly keeps calendars and approvals; new links come from Trizlink, with expiry for time-limited posts. Loomly's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Metricool to Trizlink
item.description: Metricool keeps posting and competitor reports; its paid-tier bio page moves to Trizlink's free one. Metricool's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Milkshake to Trizlink
item.description: Turn a Milkshake site into one Trizlink bio page and keep sign-ups inside the product. Milkshake's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Mixpost to Trizlink
item.description: Mixpost stays on your server for posting; hand Trizlink the links and bio page you no longer want to host. Mixpost's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Pallyy to Trizlink
item.description: Pallyy keeps posting and client approvals; each client's bio page moves to its own Trizlink workspace. Pallyy's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Pillar to Trizlink
item.description: Pillar keeps the store; Trizlink takes the links page and the contact form. Pillar's prices and the rows its page left out, dated.

item.title: Moving from Planable to Trizlink
item.description: Client sign-off stays in Planable. Set up one Trizlink workspace per client for links and bio pages. Planable's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Publer to Trizlink
item.description: Publer keeps posting; rebuild Linkie as a Trizlink bio page you arrange yourself. Publer's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Rebrandly to Trizlink
item.description: Bring Rebrandly links across with passwords and end dates intact, and rebuild the link gallery as a bio page. Rebrandly's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Sendible to Trizlink
item.description: Sendible keeps scheduling; each client gets a Trizlink workspace for links and bio pages. Sendible's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Short.io to Trizlink
item.description: Move links off Short.io while its custom domains keep serving the old ones, and set device rules again. Short.io's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from SocialBee to Trizlink
item.description: Keep SocialBee's recycling categories and give each evergreen post a Trizlink short link. SocialBee's prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Sprout Social to Trizlink
item.description: Sprout Social keeps publishing and reports; link-making moves to a Trizlink workspace. Sprout's per-seat prices, dated.

item.title: Moving from Switchy to Trizlink
item.description: Moving from Switchy starts with your pixels, and the redirect trade-off a pixel brings on Trizlink. Switchy's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from T2M to Trizlink
item.description: Leave T2M's lifetime links alone and move the rest, passwords and expiry included. T2M's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from Taplink to Trizlink
item.description: Rebuild a Taplink page in Trizlink: timed blocks become a countdown, forms and pixels move. Taplink's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from TinyURL to Trizlink
item.description: Move the TinyURL links you still edit into Trizlink and leave the forgotten ones be. TinyURL's prices, and what its page did not say, dated.

item.title: Moving from Vista Social to Trizlink
item.description: Vista Social keeps publishing; the Vista Page becomes a Trizlink bio page. Vista Social's prices and features, dated.

item.title: Moving from YOURLS to Trizlink
item.description: Pull links from your own YOURLS database into a Trizlink CSV, and keep the server up until traffic drops. YOURLS facts, dated.

item.title: Moving from Zoho Social to Trizlink
item.description: Run Trizlink beside Zoho Social for links and a bio page, with UTM templates your CRM can rely on. Zoho Social's prices, dated.

item.title: Referrals
item.description: Invite someone to Trizlink and earn points and a dated badge on every confirmed referral, plus a month of a paid plan once you reach the threshold, with every number set in the admin panel rather than fixed in the product.

item.title: Update Trizlink when a release is ready
item.description: Understand a normal release notice, an urgent update block and what the Update action means.

item.title: Use Trizlink on your phone
item.description: Find the four bottom tabs, open the full workspace menu and locate New link on Dashboard or Links.

item.title: Publish a Trizlink release
item.description: Choose the platform, channel, version and severity that control when people must update Trizlink.

item.title: Share a link
item.description: Share your referral link from Referrals, copy a short link, and set the preview a social platform may show.

item.title: About the Trizlink team
item.description: Trizlink is built and maintained by the Trizlink team. Product questions go to the contact page on trizlink.com, or to support@trizlink.com.

item.title: Browser extension
item.description: Trizlink does not offer a browser extension. Here is why, what to use instead to shorten a link quickly, and what would have to be true for one to ship.

item.title: Theme control
item.description: One panel, nine appearance axes, applied before the first paint from a single registry. Preferences are held on the device rather than synced to your account.

item.title: AI assistance
item.description: Trizlink's AI runs on our credit at your plan's level, with monthly AI and voice allowances on every plan; your own Anthropic or OpenAI key lifts both, Free included.

item.title: AI levels and voice
item.description: Every Trizlink plan includes AI at one of three levels, Spark, Pulse or Surge, with monthly AI and voice allowances. Your own Anthropic or OpenAI key lifts both.

item.title: Page tours and the product walkthrough
item.description: Press Tour this page for a short guided tour of the page you are on. The product walkthrough shows how Trizlink works, one real screen per step.

item.title: Frequently asked questions
item.description: Short answers to what people actually ask about Trizlink — plans, sign-in, custom domains, the missing browser extension, AI metering, the API and what happened to old links.

item.title: Introduction to Trizlink
item.description: Trizlink runs short links, bio pages and social posts out of one workspace, with a single analytics layer across all three. What it does, what it does not, and where the limits are.

item.title: Workspaces and teams
item.description: A Trizlink workspace is the tenant that owns links, bio pages and analytics. Four roles and seven capabilities on every plan; teams and the audit log on Team.

item.title: Create your account
item.description: Sign in to Trizlink with your Google account, meet the workspace created for you, and learn how deletion, the 30-day window and the rebuild data reset work before you start.

item.title: QR codes
item.description: Every Trizlink short link can be drawn as a QR code, derived from the address each time rather than stored, with four error-correction levels and optional separate scan counting.

item.title: Quick start
item.description: Create your first Trizlink short link, draw its QR code, publish a bio page and read the click breakdowns, with the limits of each step stated as you go.

item.title: Changelog
item.description: Notable changes to Trizlink and to this documentation site, latest first. Version 2.13.0 rebuilt the product on a new database and did not carry old data across.

item.title: Privacy and data
item.description: What Trizlink stores, what it deliberately does not store, and why no visitor IP address exists in the database. A plain summary alongside the legal text.

item.title: Public API
item.description: Eighteen REST endpoints at api.trizlink.com/v1 for links, bio pages, analytics, domains, webhooks and social posts, with per-resource scopes and separate destructive permissions.

item.title: Link organisation
item.description: Folders, labels and collections are three different structures in Trizlink, not three names for one. Plus CSV import of up to 5,000 rows, parsed in your browser.

item.title: Social publishing
item.description: Compose one post, preview it per network and queue it per account. Trizlink's social publishing is built and currently publishes nothing, and this page says why.

item.title: Utility tools
item.description: A curated directory of 48 free browser tools hosted on ZTools, a separate product. Trizlink's own tools suite was retired in July 2026 and the directory replaced it.

item.title: Widgets
item.description: Embed a Trizlink link, bio page or collection on any site in four shapes — inline, button, popup or QR — with a snippet generated from the widget rather than stored.

item.title: Analytics
item.description: Trizlink records one row per click with country, device, referrer and browser, stores no visitor IP address, and reports refused visits alongside successful ones.

item.title: Custom domains
item.description: Add a domain you own to Trizlink and prove it with three DNS records. Verification works today; serving short links on a verified domain is not live yet.

item.title: Bio pages
item.description: A Trizlink bio page is one public address holding every link you would otherwise have to choose between, built from fifteen block types on three layouts, with drafts, passwords and view counts.

item.title: Short links
item.description: A Trizlink short link is a short address that resolves to a destination you can change, with optional passwords, expiry, click ceilings, geo and device targeting and A/B splits.

item.title: Tracking and UTM
item.description: Attach tracking pixels to Trizlink links, save UTM templates, receive webhooks on ten link and workspace events, and record conversions with a beacon that stores no visitor address.
